terms: adults aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor

coverage_gaps: No citation-graph or DOI-metadata route is available for systematic backward and forward citation chasing beyond links exposed in PubMed and the registry.
No regulator route outside FDA is available, so EMA and other jurisdictional actions cannot be assessed within this plan.
No Embase or other subscription subject index is available, which may reduce recall for conference abstracts and non-MEDLINE journals.
No preprint route is available for unpublished or not-yet-indexed qualifying evidence through the cutoff.
Full-text availability is not guaranteed by the supplied routes, so details absent from indexed abstracts, registry fields, or FDA documents may require later escalation.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude nonhuman, in vitro, and mechanistic-only studies without decision-relevant human safety evidence.
Exclude indications other than rheumatoid arthritis unless the record is an FDA action that explicitly governs RA use or supplies indispensable dose-specific safety context.
Exclude efficacy-only reports that provide no cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, or overall serious-safety information.
Exclude records first published, posted, updated, or made effective after 2024-12-31 from the as-of synthesis while listing them only as post-cutoff exclusions if encountered.
Exclude narrative commentary, news, and opinion as evidentiary support when they add no original data, formal evidence synthesis, correction status, or regulatory action.
Exclude duplicate canonical records from evidence counts while retaining duplicate hit provenance and linked versions.
Exclude pooled JAK-inhibitor conclusions that do not provide separable tofacitinib or RA evidence from drug-specific effect estimates.
Exclude claims whose population, exposure dose, comparator, outcome definition, or temporal provenance cannot be determined sufficiently for the intended safety comparison.
inclusion_criteria: Records must concern human rheumatoid arthritis treated with tofacitinib or directly contextualize an FDA action applying to tofacitinib in RA.
Include the pivotal postauthorization trial registry, its results history, primary publication, linked secondary analyses, and all linked correction or retraction notices available by the cutoff.
Include FDA safety communications, prescribing-information revisions, boxed warnings, review materials, and use restrictions effective on or before 2024-12-31.
Include comparative evidence reporting cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality with extractable population, dose, comparator, follow-up, and effect information.
Include qualifying or conflicting randomized, observational, registry, claims-based, systematic-review, and meta-analytic evidence when its design and applicability to RA can be assessed.
Retain records in any language when an English title or abstract permits relevance screening; require accessible interpretable details before using the record for quantitative conclusions.
Apply the cutoff to publication, online-first, registry-update, and regulatory effective dates separately and retain each date type in provenance.
Merge canonical records by stable identifiers while preserving every query-to-record occurrence and every registry-publication-regulatory linkage.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal registry record by exact identifier and capture study aliases, protocol design, enrolled risk population, dose arms, comparator, outcomes, results, sponsor study number, linked publications, and registry history through the cutoff.
Recover the primary pivotal publication by exact locator and verify its identifiers, title, trial linkage, publication dates, outcome definitions, effect estimates, and linked notices.
Recover the principal FDA class and tofacitinib safety action and identify its effective date, evidentiary basis, affected indications, boxed-warning changes, and prescribing restrictions.

queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690,550"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find syntheses that contextualize absolute and relative risks while retaining their study mix, dose, comparator, follow-up, heterogeneity, and temporal limitations.

question_frame: PECO safety frame: adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib, with the pivotal cardiovascular-risk-enriched postauthorization population analyzed separately; exposure is tofacitinib with dose-specific handling; comparator is primarily tumor necrosis factor inhibitors and secondarily other active RA therapies or background incidence; outcomes are major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and all-cause or cause-specific mortality; evidence linkage must connect the pivotal trial registry, primary publication, FDA safety actions, qualifying or conflicting studies, and correction, retraction, withdrawal, or expression-of-concern status through the cutoff.
stop_rules: Complete all 16 prespecified query events across the three selected routes and record exact query, execution timestamp, result count, requested cutoff, and provider version when available.

Do not stop before recovering and identifier-linking NCT02092467, the primary publication, and the principal FDA cardiovascular, cancer, thrombosis, and death action, or documenting a route-specific retrieval failure.
Do not stop before each of cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality has primary pivotal evidence plus a completed qualifying-or-conflicting evidence search.
Do not stop before PubMed linked-record metadata and the dedicated challenge query establish correction, erratum, retraction, withdrawal, and expression-of-concern status through 2024-12-31.
Stop expansion when two consecutive completed expansion searches add no new decision-relevant canonical evidence or study-family links after deduplication.
Stop at the hard cap of 16 query events even if saturation is not reached and report unresolved outcomes, missing anchors, route failures, and budget exhaustion as coverage gaps.
Stop synthesis escalation when further retrieval within the available routes cannot change the direction, confidence, applicability, or regulatory interpretation of any decision-critical conclusion.
Fail closed on conflicting records sharing an identifier until the conflict is resolved; consistent duplicate hits remain linked and do not prevent completion.
